### Added

- *(organizations)* Organizations-admin role and admission policies of organization namespaces in [#1270](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1270) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(organizations)* The operator's access for the erasure of deleted organizations in [#1271](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1271) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- Air-gapped install from a mirror registry with credentials and CA in [#1264](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1264) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(organizations)* Deploy agent-platform-operator, remove the tenants mode, select organization namespaces by the agent-platform label in [#1272](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1272) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(organizations)* Agent-platform:organization-flux and the pins of the operator's Kustomizations in [#1273](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1273) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- Default ModelConfig annotation and kagent's default ModelConfig switch in [#1276](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1276) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Agent-platform-operator trusts ate-api through the projected ClusterTrustBundle in [#1282](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1282) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(kagent)* Take the 1.31 line, ListSessions filters by the Agent's namespace in [#1281](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1281) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(agent-manager)* Take the 2.19 line, which reports the namespace's default model in [#1288](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1288) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(operator)* Take agent-platform-operator 0.1.x in [#1289](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1289) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(substrate)* Take Substrate 1.18 and the Google access-token plugin 0.3, whose Secret readers are bound by namespace in [#1293](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1293) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(kagent)* Declare no model in the charts in [#1295](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1295) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(organizations)* AgentPlatformOrganizations.enabled turns on agent-manager's organization tools in [#1298](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1298) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/agent-manager docker tag to v2.19.0 in [#1266](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1266) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/oauth2-proxy docker tag to v7.15.6 in [#1294](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1294) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/agent-manager docker tag to v2.20.3 in [#1299](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1299) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])

### Fixed

- *(muster)* Trust the actor JWT whenever Substrate is on, not only with workspaces in [#1284](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1284) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(harness)* Stop forwarding the person's token to MCP servers in [#1285](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1285) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(tenants)* A HelmRelease in the kagent namespace is an agent release in [#1283](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1283) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(substrate)* The credential providers read Secrets only where an actor's grant points in [#1286](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1286) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(components)* Drop the cluster-manager version ceiling in [#1280](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1280) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(postgres)* Allow ImageVolume mounts in restore workloads in [#852](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/852) by [@danielgaskins](https://github.com/danielgaskins)
- *(connectivity)* Ask the authorizer once per distinct Secret in the credential policies in [#1296](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1296) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Security

- *(hooks)* The connectivity hooks read only the Secrets they write in [#1275](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1275) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
